bundle.shortDescription: Medicinal and economically important plants of India
bundle.longDescription: Version 1: Sasya Sampada 2, the plant resources database of Jeeva Sampada, as a program of its own: 1,956 medicinal and economically important plants with classification, common names, floras, distribution maps, web pages, pictures, accessions, uses, pests and patents.
